title: Weleda says unauthorized access to its online shop may have exposed customer and credit card records
date_note: Date of Weleda's announcement as reported by ASCII.jp; the page gives no earlier day for the announcement.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source; no city given
summary: ASCII.jp reports that Weleda announced on 24 November that unauthorized access to its official online shop may have leaked customer records and credit card records, the latter including security codes. According to the report, the company gives the cause as unauthorized access exploiting a system vulnerability, and its announcement does not state that fraudulent use was confirmed.
plain: Weleda says its online shop was accessed without authorization and customer records and card records may have leaked. Its announcement does not state that fraud was confirmed.
exec: Weleda says customer records and credit card records, including security codes, may have leaked; its announcement does not state that fraudulent use was confirmed.
action: Weleda asks users to check card statements and contact their card company about any charge they do not recognise.

evidence.quote: ヴェレダは11月24日、公式オンラインショップへの不正アクセスにより顧客情報19万8792件とクレジットカード情報4万5689件が漏えいした可能性があると発表した。
カード情報の対象は、同じ期間にカード決済した4万5689人。

validation.note: ASCII.jp and ZDNet Korea (two independent publishers) each report Weleda's 24 November announcement of possible exposure of customer and card records. Weleda's own notice was not read.

review.note: date, counts, cause, no confirmed fraud, advice checked against ASCII.jp and ZDNet Korea
